scope: Implement Pello Phase 3C increments 3C-1, 3C-2, and 3C-3 sequentially; local planning only.
stop_control: Check runtime/phase3c/STOP immediately before each SDK model operation and any external operation; the latter are prohibited in this run.
accounting: Count actual SDK model invocations only; deterministic local test runs are recorded separately. No monetary budget is claimed because this runtime cannot enforce live billing amounts.
exhaustion_policy: Stop the affected increment, preserve resumable state, and do not extend any hard limit without a new user authorization.
authorization_source: User request to execute Phase 3C; selected bounded operational limits recorded before implementation.
